title: Among female superheroes with blue eyes, find those whose strength attribut
question: Among female superheroes with blue eyes, find those whose strength attribute value is at least 85, and return their names, strength values, and height in centimeters. Order the results by strength descending, then by height descending.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019", T2."XCL_011", T1."XCL_028"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1."XCL_021" = T3."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN colour AS T4 ON T1."XCL_022" = T4."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T2."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T3."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND T4."XCL_006" = 'Blue'
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  AND T2."XCL_011" >= 85
ORDER BY T2."XCL_011" DESC, T1."XCL_028" DESC
